notes: Stories created for Local Disk Resilience with full lifecycle coverage.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for file operation resilience
Added core retry and fallback logic story
Added API/interface layer for resilient file operations
Added unit and failure scenario test suite
Added integration with existing services using file IO

BL-0.1.4-005-S1.title: Define File Operation Resilience Schema and Contract
BL-0.1.4-005-S1.description: Define a standard contract for local file operations including retry policy, error classification (transient vs fatal), fallback behavior, and metadata logging requirements.
BL-0.1.4-005-S1.evidence: ASSUMPTION: No standardized file operation contract exists; GAP requires unified schema for resilience behavior

BL-0.1.4-005-S2.title: Implement Retry and Fallback Logic for File Operations
BL-0.1.4-005-S2.description: Build core logic to handle local disk failures including configurable retries, exponential backoff, safe fallback (e.g., temp storage or skip with logging), and atomic write protection.
BL-0.1.4-005-S2.evidence: ASSUMPTION: Local disk writes are used without resilience; GAP requires retry/fallback engine

BL-0.1.4-005-S3.title: Expose Resilient File Operation Utility Interface
BL-0.1.4-005-S3.description: Provide a shared utility/module for all services to perform safe file reads/writes using the resilience layer, ensuring consistent usage across the backend.
BL-0.1.4-005-S3.evidence: Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py (pattern for shared utilities); ASSUMPTION: similar shared abstraction needed for file IO

BL-0.1.4-005-S4.title: Unit and Failure Scenario Tests for File Resilience
BL-0.1.4-005-S4.description: Create tests simulating disk failures, partial writes, permission errors, and recovery scenarios to validate retry logic, fallback behavior, and data integrity.
BL-0.1.4-005-S4.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/test_debug_logger.py (existing testing patterns); ASSUMPTION: resilience testing not present

BL-0.1.4-005-S5.title: Integrate Resilience Layer into Existing File-Dependent Services
BL-0.1.4-005-S5.description: Integrate the resilience utility into services that rely on local disk operations (e.g., logging, caching, temp artifacts) ensuring no direct unsafe file access remains.

BL-0.1.4-005.mitigation: Limit scope to local retry/fallback only; avoid introducing distributed storage changes
